system.description:
The blows of swords, arrows and even the sun may still damage your body, but they no longer weaken it.

You suffer no wound penalties for damage beyond the Bruised level, until you are driven to torpor or Final Death. No matter how grievously injured you are, the worst penalty you receive is being one Trait down on tied challenges. The benefit is passive and constant, requiring no expenditure and no challenge; Survival serves for any retest of Fortitude.
